assumptions.chosen: By the kind of the residual item in the decision record recorded for the acceptance decision (the decision-record artifact it references): kinds "should" (unverified should-criteria) and "advisory_constraint" (advisory constraints) go to "Noted"; every other kind ("not_proven", "unconfirmed_finding", "finding", "verifier", "scan", "waiver") goes to "Needs your review". This is the same split the product already uses for what counts as "would be accepted without proof" (the decision explanation and the Decisions page count exactly the items outside "should" and "advisory_constraint"), so waivers and unconfirmed findings need review.
assumptions.question: Which recorded items go into "Needs your review" and which into "Noted"; in particular where do waived must-criteria and material findings the control system could not reproduce go, which the intent does not name?

assumptions.chosen: In the order in which the recorded decision record lists them (the order the flat list shows today), keeping only the items of that group.
assumptions.question: In which order are the items listed inside a group?

interface.ui: Sign-in for the gate preview: GET /auth/preview (redirects to / with an owner session). Decisions page: route /decisions; each open acceptance decision is a list item containing exactly one link (role link) to /tasks/{id} (id = decimal digits) whose whole visible text is "{task key} · {task title}", e.g. "T4 · Demo: share a list". Task page: route /tasks/{id}, document title "Task · Agents", h1 whose visible text contains the task key and the task title; an open decision is shown in a section introduced by an element whose whole visible text is "Your decision" (case as rendered: the label may be rendered in uppercase by styling) followed by an h2 with the decision title. Text matching rule: the "visible text" of an element is its rendered text content with surrounding whitespace removed and inner runs of whitespace collapsed to one space; "an element whose whole visible text is X" means some element on the page has exactly that text. NEW on the task page of an open acceptance decision whose recorded decision record lists at least one item accepted without proof: the items are shown in up to two groups. Each group consists of a label element whose whole visible text is exactly "Needs your review" respectively "Noted", and a list (ul, role list) that is the label element's next sibling element and contains one list item (li, role listitem) per item of that group. The whole visible text of each list item is the item's text exactly as listed today: "{id}: {text}" when the item has an id, otherwise "{text}". The "Needs your review" group, when shown, comes before the "Noted" group in document order. A group with no items is not shown (neither its label nor its list); when there are no items at all, neither label and no item list is shown. Grouping rule: A1. Preview demo data (unchanged): Demo Project task T4 "Demo: share a list" has an open acceptance decision whose recorded decision record lists, in this order, "AC1: [low] Demo finding: the share link is not shortened" (kind finding), "the independent Verifier did not check AC2 (the gate did)" (kind verifier) and "AC3: should-criterion not verified" (kind should); task T5 "Demo: book covers" has an open acceptance decision whose recorded decision record lists only "AC2: should-criterion not verified" (kind should). Demo tasks T1 "Demo: export a list as CSV" (open decision of kind contract_approval, badge "Contract review" on /decisions) and T2 (open decision of kind block, badge "Decision" on /decisions) have no decision record.

non_goals: Changing the wording of any item, the decision title, the explanation paragraph, the "Your decision" label, the buttons or links of the acceptance decision, or any other part of the task page.

Adding test-only attributes (such as data-* or ids) for the sake of checking; the checks rely on the visible elements named in the interface.

scope.summary: On the task page (/tasks/{id}), in the "Your decision" section of an open acceptance decision, the list of items the recorded decision record would accept without proof is shown in two groups instead of one flat list: first a group labelled "Needs your review" (unproven requirements, findings, what the Verifier did not check or could not verify, scanner results, and the other items that count as accepted without proof), then a group labelled "Noted" (unverified should-criteria and advisory constraints). Which group an item belongs to follows from the kind of the item in the recorded decision record (A1). A group with no items is not shown; when the decision has no such items at all, no group and no list is shown, as today. The text of each item, the order of items within a group, the decision's title and explanation, the buttons and every other part of the task page stay as they are. Decision records themselves, how they are computed, stored and hashed, and the Decisions page are not changed. The gate preview's existing demo tasks T4 and T5 (with their recorded decision records) are enough to check the feature black-box; the demo data is not changed.
